```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())   
library(here)
library(tidyverse)  
library(ape)
library(Rphylopars)
library(patchwork)
library(phytools)
set.seed(1010)
```

# 1. Load dataset 
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS.rds"))

phylo_tree <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/phylo_tree.rds"))

```

```{r}
chem_groups <- c("Arthropod_control", "Auxiliary_other",
                 "Fungal_control", "Vertebrate_control",
                 "Plant_control", "Mixed_multitarget")

fits_dir <- here("model_output/phylogenetic_signal")
dir.create(fits_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# 2. Pagel’s λ by chemical (phytools)
```{r eval=FALSE}
build_wide_nomask <- function(dat, chemgroup) {
  wide <- dat %>%
    filter(duration == "24", chem_group == chemgroup) %>%
    group_by(latin, CAS) %>%
    summarise(val = mean(log_sensi, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = CAS, values_from = val) %>%
    rename(species = latin) %>%
    distinct()
  if (nrow(wide) == 0) return(NULL)
  rownames(wide) <- wide$species
  wide
}

lambda_one_trait <- function(vec_named, tree) {
  vec_named <- vec_named[!is.na(vec_named)]
  keep <- intersect(names(vec_named), tree$tip.label)
  
  tree_k <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, keep))
  x_k <- vec_named[keep]
  fit <- try(phylosig(tree_k, x_k, method = "lambda", test = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    return(tibble(lambda = NA_real_, logL = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = length(keep)))
    }
  tibble(lambda = unname(fit$lambda),
         logL = unname(fit$logL),
         p = unname(fit$P),
         n = length(keep))
}

compute_and_save_lambda <- function(groups, dat, tree, out_dir, fits_dir) {
  all <- vector("list", length(groups)); names(all) <- groups

  for (g in groups) {
    message("Computing λ for group: ", g)
    wide <- build_wide_nomask(dat, g)
    if (is.null(wide)) next
    cas_cols <- setdiff(colnames(wide), "species")

    df_g <- purrr::map_dfr(cas_cols, function(cas) {
      vec <- setNames(wide[[cas]], wide$species)
      out <- lambda_one_trait(vec, tree)
      dplyr::mutate(out, chem_group = g, CAS = cas, .before = 1)
    }) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(p_adj_BH_group = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%  
      dplyr::arrange(desc(lambda))

    # save per group
    readr::write_csv(df_g, file.path(out_dir,  paste0("phytools_lambda_by_CAS_", g, ".csv")))
    saveRDS(df_g,       file.path(fits_dir,    paste0("phytools_lambda_by_CAS_", g, ".rds")))
    all[[g]] <- df_g
  }

  all_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(all[!vapply(all, is.null, logical(1))])
  if (nrow(all_df)) {
    all_df <- all_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(p_adj_BH_overall = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%  
      dplyr::relocate(p_adj_BH_overall, .after = p_adj_BH_group)

    readr::write_csv(all_df, file.path(out_dir, "phytools_lambda_by_CAS_ALL.csv"))
    saveRDS(all_df,       file.path(fits_dir, "phytools_lambda_by_CAS_ALL.rds"))
  }
  invisible(all_df)
}

# --- run it -------------------------------------------------------------------
lambda_results_all <- compute_and_save_lambda(
  groups  = chem_groups,
  dat     = spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS,
  tree    = phylo_tree,
  out_dir = out_dir,
  fits_dir = fits_dir
)
```
Since it takes time to calculate the phylogenetic signal per chemical, here we directly load the pre-calculated results.

# Summaries of Pagel's λ
```{r}
# load the output
# ---- load precomputed results -----------------------------------------------
# Paths we expect:
all_path   <- file.path(fits_dir, "phytools_lambda_by_CAS_ALL.rds")
group_glob <- file.path(fits_dir, "phytools_lambda_by_CAS_*.rds")

if (file.exists(all_path)) {
  lambda_results_all <- readRDS(all_path)
} else {
  rds_files <- Sys.glob(group_glob)
  stopifnot(length(rds_files) > 0)
  lambda_results_all <- purrr::map_dfr(rds_files, readRDS)
}

# Make sure expected columns exist and (re)compute overall BH across ALL chemicals
lambda_results_all <- lambda_results_all %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH_group   = if (!"p_adj_BH_group" %in% names(.)) p.adjust(p, method = "BH") else p_adj_BH_group,
    p_adj_BH_overall = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

# ---- summaries by chemical group --------------------------------------------
phylo_signal_sum <- lambda_results_all %>%
  group_by(chem_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_chem        = sum(!is.na(lambda)),
    median_lambda = median(lambda, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_lambda    = IQR(lambda, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_lambda   = mean(lambda, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_lambda     = sd(lambda, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_lambda    = min(lambda, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lambda    = max(lambda, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_lambda_ge_0.5 = mean(lambda >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_lambda_le_0.3 = mean(lambda <= 0.3, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_n      = median(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_n         = min(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_n         = max(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    sig_within_FDR05  = sum(p_adj_BH_group   < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sig_overall_FDR05 = sum(p_adj_BH_overall < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_lambda))

saveRDS(phylo_signal_sum, file = here(fits_dir, "phylo_signal_sum.rds"))
```
